messages:
marco: Quick sync 12: were three days from the webinar. need final AV checklist, speaker bios for the registration page, and a plan for the live demo fallback. who can take which?

elaine: I can update bios. please send short bullets (role, one-sentence achievement, fun fact). deadline EOD tomorrow.

marco: noted. short bios I want: host, 2 product leads, 1 engineer. example: "Sam, Head of Product - led inference runtime that cut p99 by 30% - kayaker"

tom: i'll own AV and recording. checklist draft: mic test, screen-share check, presenter video on/off test, backup slide deck, backup demo video, stream key verified, recording TTL.

design: i'll produce a 16:9 backup slide with "Demo Failed? Watch backup video" + S3 link card. need the video by tomorrow noon.

rita: on demo fallback: plan A = live endpoint using redwood-prod, Plan B = hot standby model (quantized) in us-west, Plan C = recorded video. during rehearsal we'll simulate endpoint throttling and flip to standby.

marco: exact steps for failover please, tom. include the CLI toggles so hosting knows when to switch.

tom: putting it here:
```
# failover script (demo)
# 1) throttle live endpoint on infra side
infractl throttle --endpoint demo-gen --rate 10rps
# 2) switch client routing
set-routing --policy fallback --model redwood-x-q4
# 3) verify metrics
metrics tail --tags demo-session --keys latency,errors
```

hosting-bot: Dress rehearsal scheduled: 2026-05-09T18:00:00Z. Channel: #marketing-dress-rehearsals. Recording enabled.

ops-bot: Reminder: run chaos test only during rehearsal window. Alerting will be muted for the session.

elaine: registration numbers: 1,128 total, 312 enterprise, 486 startups, 330 mid-market. good split for AB invite test.

marco: great. for the registration page we need single-line speaker blurbs + LinkedIn links. elaine, please push to the CMS and tag speakers with persona (enterprise/startup).

design: I also need headshots (square, 600px) and preferred pronouns. drop them in the share folder.

rita: rehearsal script note: the panel Q should start with 3 seeded questions, then open to audience. I'll prepare 8 seed Qs -> share by 2026-05-07.

tom: backup video uploaded to S3: https://s3.redwood.ai/webinars/may12-demo-backup.mp4. Will test playback in rehearsal.

marco: recording & post-event assets: ops, can we get the transcript + trimmed clips (2-3 clips: demo highlight, benchmark claim, CTA) within 48h?

ops-bot: Affirmative. Transcript + three clips queued. ETA 48 hours post-event.

marco: last housekeeping: please confirm speaker availability for the dress rehearsal time (hosting-bot, ping them in channel). if any conflicts, we'll do an alternative dry-run on 2026-05-08.

elaine: confirmed with all speakers except one (Sam might be out). i'll follow up and update calendar event.

marco: perfect. action items:
- elaine: bios + CMS update (due 2026-05-06)
- tom: AV checklist + failover script copy (due 2026-05-07)
- design: backup slide + headshot card (due 2026-05-06)
- rita: seeded Qs + demo fallback doc (due 2026-05-07)
- hosting-bot/ops-bot: confirm recording + post-event asset queue (done)

marco: thanks team 10: we'll run full dress at 18:00Z on the 9th. :white_check_mark:
